description: Runs one flow check once, now, in a real browser, and returns each step's result. Use it after adding a flow or shipping a fix. Doesn't change the flow's state or send alerts; a failing flow closes on its next scheduled pass. Takes up to a minute or two. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

name: run_flow_check
title: Run a flow check now
